{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Drop QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~(sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Drop refunded orders for revenue analysis (since refunded money is returned)
# But note: we may still want to analyze conversion rate, which includes all orders
sales_converted = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the final shape
print(f"Final number of completed orders (after removing QA and refunded): {len(sales_converted)}")"}
